args.note: Cold read B complete: read all 54 pages cold, reported per issue with verdicts (put down p.1/p.19/none; next issue yes/yes/yes). Biggest leaks: page 1's person-less splash, page 19's phantom train, the unexplained Tomas Reed portrait, and the printed ISSUE QUESTIONs. Strongest pulls: the p.2 debt display, the p.36 unsealing, and the Issue 03 negotiation/Leona material.

args.note: I wrote cold-read.md. Issue 01 held me all the way through: put down none, next issue yes. Issue 02 lost me at page 20: put down page 20, next issue yes, but only because of Ada on pages 34–36. Issue 03: put down page 47 (the negotiation), next book no. The biggest leaks: the water-wall cliffhanger is never resolved and Issue 02 opens on an unexplained train; pages 20–33 read as balloons with no scene around them; Lock never speaks; the Maker's Seal shows up out of nowhere; there are two Tomases; and the names Mera/Mara and Vey/Veyra are too close. The strongest material is Bi11bot's voice, the debt screen on page 2, and Ada and Leona on pages 38–41. I read the ISSUE QUESTION lines as printed, and they and the final caption read like homework questions.
